create_cached_dataset_from_iterable: create a cached pytorch dataset from an iterable and serialize it to an h5py file on disk
build_cached_dataset_with_limit: build a cached dataset from an iterable storing only the first n elements using take_n parameter
test_cached_dataset_iteration: test iterating over a cached dataset and retrieving items by index
refactor_cached_dataset_pickle: refactor the cached dataset to use a custom unpickler that remaps pixenv module paths to silk
review_cached_dataset_serialization: review the cached dataset serialization using h5py opaque dtype and pickle for python objects
